title: Frog Laughing
blurb: The laughing frog — a wheezy, squeaky amphibian cackle that sounds exactly like your weirdest friend losing it at 2am. It became a beloved reaction sound because it's somehow funnier than the joke it responds to. Use it when something is stupid-funny rather than clever-funny; the frog specializes in the former. Genuinely impossible to hear without smiling.
origin: A viral clip of a frog making a laugh-like squeak.
